subject: general
question: Which of the following is the largest west flowing river in Peninsular India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narmada**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Narmada river originates in the** Amarkantak plateau** in Madhya Pradesh.

 
 
• It is the largest west-flowing river in Peninsular India.
 
• It flows through **Gujarat, Chhattisgarh Madhya Pradesh, and Maharashtra**.
 
• The tributaries of the Narmada River are **Kolar River, Shakkar River, Dudhi River, Tawa River, and Hiran River**.
 
• The major Hydro Power projects in the basin are** Indira Sagar, Sardar Sarovar, Omkareshwar, Bargi & Maheshwar**.
 
• **Dhuadhar falls** were formed by the Narmada river.
